verdict.rationale: Reflect documents #tags as a first-class organizing primitive. Search can filter notes by #tags and combine as many filters as needed, and Kindle sync auto-tags imported notes as #book, so tag-based organization and retrieval is delivered. Nothing in the pack shows typed properties or metadata fields (dates, numbers, selects) attached to notes. missing for 10: typed properties/metadata fields on notes, querying or filtering by property values, tag management or hierarchy details, independent or hands-on corroboration of tag workflows.
